Nina (People Ops): Quick sync  — Rae is planning parental leave starting 2027-02-01 for ~10 weeks. We need to lock payroll supplement, decide on backfill, and handle the mid-cycle checkin scheduled for 2027-02-10. Can folks volunteer coverage?

Rae: Yep 2/1 start. Will file FMLA today and want to be fully offline first 6 weeks, then reduced hours 12/wk after that. I can prep a 1-page handoff + runbook.

Omar (Eng): I can take weekly oncall handover and cover high-priority incident triage weeks 1. Can also own the candidate debriefs while you're out. PST timezone.

Sasha (Hiring): I suggest a 10-week temp req at 0.6 FTE if you want feature continuity. I can post once cost center and dates confirmed. Rae, any specific skills for the contractor?

Rae: Prefer someone with infra + deployment experience, familiar with our CI. Will add acceptance criteria in the handoff doc tonight.

Nina (People Ops): Payroll: to get Redwood top-up Rae needs to sign the Supplement Election by payroll cutoff 2027-01-20. Payroll-bot will ping on 2027-01-06 and 2027-01-15. Also confirm whether the team will front contractor cost or use central buffer.

Payroll-bot: Reminder scheduled: Supplement Election form due 2027-01-20 for Rae. Leave request ID LR-20270201-03.

Omar (Eng): For the mid-cycle checkin 2/10  my recommendation: mark the formal calibration as "deferred" and add a short note in the review system: "on parental leave; will reopen 4 weeks after return". We can do an optional pre-leave 15m sync to capture anything actionable.

Sasha (Hiring): I'll draft REQ-TEMP-7731 and placeholder posting. Cost estimate for 10 weeks @ 0.6 FTE = ~$18k. Which cost center?

Nina (People Ops): Use cost center 4421-ENG-SQUADB if Omar okays. Action items: Sasha post temp req by 2026-12-15; Rae upload FMLA + upload Supplement Election by 2027-01-20; Omar to add himself to oncall rota and own debriefs; People Ops to set review to deferred before 2027-02-10.

Rae: I'll upload forms by 2027-01-15 and write the handoff doc tonight. Thanks all.

Sasha (Hiring): Req posted to tracker: REQ-TEMP-7731. Vendor outreach queued.

Nina (People Ops): Great. If no objections I'll finalize paperwork and trigger payroll top-up once the supplement is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
